sentences.en: The filly was named "Comet" because she was so fast.
sentences.zh: 这匹小马驹被命名为‘彗星’因为她跑得非常快。

sentences.en: Caroline Herschel was the first woman to discover a comet.
sentences.zh: 卡罗琳·赫谢尔是第一位发现彗星的女性。

sentences.en: There's no evidence that comets have any influence on viticulture.
sentences.zh: 没有证据表明彗星会对酿酒产生任何影响。

mnemonic: 联想记忆：come（来）+t→很多年才来一次的星体→彗星
